```{python}
import pandas as pd

attractions = pd.read_csv("data/attractions.csv")
top = attractions.loc[attractions["visits_2025"].idxmax()]
top_name = top["attraction"]
top_visits = f"{top['visits_2025']:,}"
total_visits = f"{attractions['visits_2025'].sum():,}"
n_free = int(attractions["admission"].str.startswith("Free").sum())
n_all = len(attractions)
```

## London in 2025

London's ten most visited ALVA member attractions drew `{python} total_visits` visits in
2025. The most visited was the `{python} top_name`, with `{python} top_visits` visits.
`{python} n_free` of these `{python} n_all` attractions have free general admission.

## Five sights to start with

1. [British Museum](https://www.britishmuseum.org/visit), Bloomsbury: free.
2. [Natural History Museum](https://www.nhm.ac.uk/visit.html), South Kensington: free.
3. [Tate Modern](https://www.tate.org.uk/visit/tate-modern), Bankside: free.
4. [National Gallery](https://www.nationalgallery.org.uk/visiting), Trafalgar Square: free.
5. [Tower of London](https://www.hrp.org.uk/tower-of-london/visit/), Tower Hill: paid.

"Free" means free general admission; some special exhibitions charge.
